questions.statement: Which word names the object you use to write your name on the paper?
questions.context: Primer dia de clases en el que cada estudiante identifica lo que hay sobre el escritorio.

options.feedback: A pencil is used to write names and answers on the paper, which is what the sentence describes.
The eraser removes what is already written and is not used to write the name the first time.
The ruler measures segments and does not write anything on the paper.
The sharpener sharpens the pencil and does not take part in the moment of writing.

questions.explanation: Los utiles escolares se agrupan segun su funcion: escribir con pencil o pen, borrar con eraser, medir con ruler y afilar con sharpener. Cuando el enunciado describe una accion concreta, la palabra buscada es la que nombra esa accion.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The books are not on the desk. They are on the shelf. Which word describes where the books are?
questions.context: Actividad de descripcion del puesto del profesor mediante preguntas de ubicacion.

options.feedback: on would indicate the books are resting on a surface, and the sentence says they are on the shelf.
in describes being inside a piece of furniture such as the shelf, where the books are kept.
under would mean the books are below the desk, and the text places them in another piece of furniture.
between needs two objects at the sides, and here only the shelf is mentioned.

questions.explanation: Los muebles de almacenamiento como el estante, el cajon o el armario se describen con in porque el objeto queda dentro de un espacio cerrado. La distincion con on aparece cuando el objeto esta apoyado y visible sobre la superficie.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "There is a big clock on the wall and many chairs in the room." What is on the wall?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto sobre lo que hay en un salon de clases.

options.feedback: The text says literally that there is a big clock on the wall.
The chairs are in the room, not on the wall, according to the second part of the text.
The board does not appear in the text, which mentions only the clock and the chairs.
The door is not mentioned in the sentence either.

questions.explanation: Este ejercicio de lectura exige seguir la preposicion del texto: cuando el enunciado pregunta por un lugar, la respuesta es el sustantivo que va inmediatamente despues de on the wall. Es una practica eficaz paraGrath comprension de texto en grado tercero.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence: "Please pass me the ___, the object I use to draw lines and shapes."
questions.context: Ejercicio en el que el docente pide a un estudiante que le pase un objeto.

options.feedback: The ruler is the instrument used to draw straight lines and geometric shapes in the notebook.
The pencil writes, but it is not used to draw straight lines of exact measurement like those of the ruler.
The glue joins papers and does not draw lines or shapes of any kind.
The scissors cut materials and their function has nothing to do with drawing lines.

questions.explanation: La pista del enunciado es funcional: describe para que sirve el objeto antes de nombrarlo. Esa estrategia, definir por la funcion y luego escoger el sustantivo, es la que permite entender vocabulario nuevo sin depender de la traduccion palabra por palabra.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The teacher says: "Put the ___ back in the drawer when you finish." Which word fits the sentence?
questions.context: Rutina de limpieza del aula al terminar la jornada escolar.

options.feedback: Books are kept on the shelf or in the backpack, not in a drawer, and the sentence asks for the drawer.
The scissors are kept in a drawer or in a case so they are not left within reach, and the sentence mentions a drawer.
The window is part of the wall and cannot be stored inside a piece of furniture.
The clock is fixed on the wall and is not stored in any drawer.

questions.explanation: Cada objeto del aula tiene un lugar de almacenamiento que responde a su tamano y a su seguridad. Los objetos cortantes como las tijeras van en el cajon, los libros en el estante y los objetos fijos como el reloj y la ventana no se guardan.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which group has only school supplies?
questions.context: Actividad de inventario de utiles para el inicio del periodo escolar.

options.text: A notebook, a computer and a book
options.feedback: The computer is an electronic device and not a school supply for writing.

options.text: A notebook, a pencil and a ruler
options.feedback: The notebook, the pencil and the ruler are the three classic school supplies in the list.

options.text: A bag, a chair and a door
options.feedback: The chair and the door are part of the classroom furniture and not objects the student brings.

options.text: A pen, a ball and a bicycle
options.feedback: The ball and the bicycle are play or transport objects, not school supplies.

questions.explanation: Distinguir utiles de mobiliario o de objetos de juego es una clasificacion basica que aparece en las pruebas. Los tres elementos correctos cumplen una funcion academica: escribir, dibujar lineas y organizar notas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the picture: four pencils are inside the pencil case. What is the correct plural of "pencil" in English?
questions.context: Ejercicio de descripcion del material que un grupo de estudiantes traen de su casa.

options.feedback: pencilies does not exist in English; nouns ending in -l form their plural with -s and not with -ies.
penciles is not an English word either and reflects an ending that belongs to Spanish.
pencilers would be the plural of penciler, which is a mechanical pencil, and not of pencil.
The regular plural is formed by adding -s to the base, and pencil gives pencils.

questions.explanation: El plural regular en ingles se construye anadiendo -s a la base, y los sustantivos que terminan en -l siguen esa misma regla. Conocer la base evita inventar terminaciones que suenan parecidas al espanol pero no existen en la lengua inglesa.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence: "I need a ___ because my pencil broke." Which object does the student need?
questions.context: Actividad de reflexion oral sobre los materiales usados en clase por el propio estudiante.

options.feedback: When a pencil breaks or loses its point, what is needed is the sharpener.
The eraser does not remove writing, it sharpens the graphite, which is exactly what the pencil in the sentence lacks.
The backpack is for carrying supplies, not for repairing a pencil that broke.
The notebook receives what is written and does not repair the damaged pencil.

questions.explanation: Comprender la relacion causa y efecto dentro del aula es una forma temprana de comprension pragmatica: el lapiz roto produce la necesidad de un afilador. El estudiante que identifica la consecuencia practica escolle el objeto correcto sin necesitar el diccionario.
questions.subject: ingles
